title: cynoglossum platycalyx
intro: Cynoglossum platycalyx, commonly known as Chinese forget-me-not, is a perennial flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of China. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, as well as supporting respiratory health. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, promote relaxation, and enhance immune function. Bioactive constituents of Cynoglossum platycalyx include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
